profile.ja: 居候の若いさくらが元いた世界に存在する『若い八津紫』。さくらと同じく学生で、五車学園で生徒会長を務めている。忽然と消えてしまったさくらの事を調査するうちに、次元侵略者ブレインフレーヤーの仕業であることを突き止めた彼女は、さくらを取り戻すべくブレインフレーヤーを探している。大人の紫に比べるとやや生硬で杓子定規過ぎるきらいはあるが、冷静沈着で質実剛健、面倒見がよく優しいが理解されにくい所や、大好きなアサギお姉さまの匂いを嗅いで「はあはあ」する趣味は変わらない。
profile.en: They are the young Yatsu Murasaki from the world where the young Sakura used to live. They are a student and serve as the student council president at Gosha Academy. While investigating Sakura's sudden disappearance, they discovered that it was the work of the dimensional invader Brain Flayer, and now they are searching for Brain Flayer to retrieve Sakura. Compared to the adult Murasaki, they may be a bit stiff and rigid, but they are calm, collected, and kind, although they can be hard to understand at times. They also have a quirky hobby of sniffing the scent of their beloved Asagi-neesama and letting out a happy sigh.

text.ja: む、お前も対魔忍か？　今は少しでも情報が欲しい……この未来世界から次元移動する方法をともに探してくれないか
text.en: Hmm, you're a Taimanin too? I need all the information I can get right now... will you help me find a way to travel through dimensions from this future world?

text.ja: ここか？　ここはブレインコアの最下層エリアアンダーク。外には荒廃した世界が広がっているなんて、思えないくらい栄えているだろ？
text.en: Is this the place? This is the lowest level of the Brain Core's Area Underdark. It's thriving to the point where you'd never guess that a devastated world lies outside.

text.ja: この武具はビッグバン・ドズというギャングのボスに貰ったものだ。乱暴者だが、自分の信念には一本筋を通す義理堅い男だよ
text.en: I got this weapon from the boss of the Big Bang Dogs gang. He's a rough guy, but he's a man of principle who sticks to his convictions.

text.ja: 荒廃したこの世界、一刻も早く脱出したい所だ……焦りは禁物？　分かっている、だが……ああ、早くまた皆に……さくらに会いたい
text.en: I want to escape this devastated world as soon as possible... I know I shouldn't be impatient, but... ah, I just want to see everyone again, especially Sakura.

text.ja: この世界では既にアサギお姉さまは……くっ、認めないぞこんな未来……この次元を変えられる可能性があるなら、協力は惜しまない
text.en: In this world, Asagi-neesama is already... no, I refuse to accept this future... if there's a possibility that we can change this dimension, I'll cooperate fully.

text.ja: 力押しでどうにかできない状況は苦手でな……しかしこれもまた鍛錬と思う事にするよ。またあの『戦略論』とやらを教えてくれ
text.en: I'm not good at handling situations that can't be resolved with brute force... but I'll consider this a training opportunity. Teach me more about that "strategy" of yours again.

text.ja: この片手斧の扱いにもだいぶ慣れたが、たまには大斧を思いっきり振り回して戦いたいな。そうだお前との手合わせなら……なぜ逃げる！？
text.en: I've gotten quite used to handling this one-handed axe, but sometimes I want to wield a large axe and swing it around wildly. That's exactly what I'd do in a spar with you... why are you running away?

text.ja: アッパーガーデンへと向かうなら、特に気をつけなければならんやつがいる。ダゴンという女王の側近だが……とにかく気を付けてくれ
text.en: If we're heading to the Upper Garden, there's someone you should be especially careful around - one of Queen Dagon's attendants... just be careful, okay?

text.ja: 奴隷娼婦の紫でぇす……今日は落札していただきありがとうございますぅ。優秀なオス様の子種をいただけるなんて、光栄です……♪
text.en: I'm Purple, the slave prostitute... thank you for bidding on me today. It's an honor to receive the seed of an excellent master like you...♪

text.ja: い、入れて、いいですよぉ……？　お゛っ！　お、お、おおぉぉ……入ったぁ……オマンコ、即堕ちぃ……お客様に恋する失格娼婦になるぅ
text.en: I-it's okay to put it in...? Ah, oh, oh, oh... it's inside... my pussy is already surrendering... I'm a prostitute who's fallen in love with the customer...

text.ja: おぉぉ～、んおぉぉ～……こんな気持ちいいスクワット覚えたらぁ……もう二度と、チンポなしで鍛錬できなくなるううぅ、お、おぉぉ
text.en: Ooh, ooh... I've never felt this good from doing squats... now that I've learned this, I'll never be able to train without a dick again... oh, ooh...
